name: Inbox sentry
description: Processes every NEW email, including concurrent bursts (set the mail account on the trigger after importing). Untrusted message content is explicitly fenced before a model-judged urgency decision; urgent/personal mail becomes a two-line alert. Classification failures produce a separate workflow warning.
